steps.title: From idea to video in three steps

s1.title: Enter your idea
s1.body: Write a few lines, paste a link, upload a table or record audio. Pick a voice and a style.

s2.title: Review script and scenes
s2.body: Check the voice-over and every scene. Edit directly or ask the chat assistant.

s3.title: Download the video
s3.body: Captions follow every word, ready to post. Download the MP4 and an SRT file.

styles.title: Thirteen styles, one click apart
styles.subtitle: Each style has its own layout, colors and motion. Your brand applies to all of them.

features.title: Everything you need to make on-brand video fast

f1.title: Natural Vietnamese voices
f1.body: Many male, female and regional voices. Listen before you choose.

f2.title: Word-accurate captions
f2.body: Captions follow the voice and keep Vietnamese diacritics intact.

f3.title: Edit by chat
f3.body: Say what to change. Undo and redo at any time.

f4.title: Brand kit
f4.body: Your colors, fonts and logo apply to every video.

f5.title: Batch and API
f5.body: Generate many videos from a table, or call the API and webhooks.

f6.title: Team work
f6.body: Invite members with view, edit or admin roles.

u2.title: Creators
u2.body: Turn posts and scripts into short videos.

u4.title: Businesses
u4.body: Consistent brand video for the whole team.

q1.q: Do I need video editing skills?
q1.a: No. Enter your idea and MakVid Studio does the rest. You can adjust it by chat.

q2.q: What does the free plan include?
q2.a: A few videos each month with a MakVid Studio mark. Upgrade to remove the mark and get more.

q3.q: How long can a video be?
q3.a: It depends on the plan. See the Pricing page.

q4.q: Can I use my own brand?
q4.a: Yes. Set colors, fonts and logo once and every video follows them.

q5.a: Each workspace is separate. You can permanently delete a project at any time.
